extracted.title: The Importance of Technology in Modern Education
extracted.author: null
key_points: Technology has transformed learning and teaching through online classes, digital libraries, and educational apps.
It provides flexibility, allowing students to learn from anywhere and at any time.
Online platforms improve communication and efficiency for assignments, quizzes, and discussions.
Interactive tools like videos and presentations make learning more engaging.
Challenges such as internet connectivity and excessive screen time exist, but technology continues to improve education systems.
